limitations: Assembly, suitable adhesive and a separate 240 mm length of 4 mm solid silicone cord, nominal 60 Shore A, are required.
The rigid legs do not walk; motion is by wheels.
Maximum two clockwise knob turns from a relaxed cord; the knob must be restrained until release.
Physical fit, running distance, traction, durability and cord retention have not been physically tested. No physical manufacture or delivery is claimed.
summary: A grey robot duck with a yellow bill, purple details and a side winding knob. A replaceable silicone cord stores the twist that drives its small wheels.
title: Microduck
what_arrives: Digital model files for 20 printable parts and the assembled model.
A six-page printable owner guide covering assembly, cord fitting, winding, reset and care.
